# SuperSplat Viewer 本地依赖

- Viewer：`@playcanvas/supersplat-viewer@1.36.2`，MIT。
- 采用 npm 官方包导出的完整 `js` / `css`，原样保存；完整 bundle 内置 PlayCanvas `2.22.6`（不是外部 peer dependency）。
- 原仓库：https://github.com/playcanvas/supersplat-viewer
- 下载来源：https://registry.npmjs.org/@playcanvas/supersplat-viewer/-/supersplat-viewer-1.36.2.tgz
- 下载包 SHA-512 integrity 已对照 npm 元数据验证。
- `LICENSE` 为 Viewer 许可证；`PLAYCANVAS-LICENSE` 为 PlayCanvas MIT 许可证（2011–2026 PlayCanvas Ltd.）。
- 演示页面运行时不请求 CDN、SuperSplat 或 PlayCanvas 服务器。
- bundle 尾部包含上游 source map 引用；source map 不参与运行，未引入。

## Host adapter (2026-10-02)

`index.js` remains the exact official upstream runtime. `host-viewer.js` is
reproducibly generated by `python3 scripts/build-viewer-adapter.py`:

- exposes the existing `captureCameraState` / `restoreCameraState` helpers as
  public handle methods `getCameraState` / `setCameraState`;
- preserves entered FOV in orbit and fly controllers;
- seeds fly yaw/pitch from the entered camera frame instead of world Euler
  axes, preserving a model's tilted horizon without turning mouse yaw into
  screen roll; damps those relative angles and clamps pitch before the poles;
- computes automatic fly-to steering in the same camera reference frame,
  while retaining world-space destinations, movement and collision;
- uses an immediate orbit/fly handoff to avoid look-at interpolation removing roll.

These are the only runtime changes. The script validates its upstream match
before writing. All native rendering, picking, sorting, capture and input-device paths
remain upstream implementations. The host particle shader uses the engine's
public GSplat work-buffer modifier and per-component uniform API.
